scope: All eight000–007 native512 PNGs opened individually using view_image; warmup not reviewed; no final-WebP review or runtime benchmarking performed.
decision: Promising pretrained baseline worthy of matched comparison and domain post-training. All eight faces look coherent; six outfits are recognizable clerical clothing and acceptable in that respect, including legitimate full white collars.000 and007 have less convincing clerical styling. Missing the prompt-specific small Roman tab alone is NOT a goal rejection. No production approval: only eight samples, no post-training, no server timing, and paired identity similarity remains unresolved.
quality_caveat: These are qualitative visual judgments at native512, not real age/gender/identity labels or objective attractiveness scores. Aesthetic appeal is subjective. Softness at512 and enlargement should be reviewed at actual site display size.

matched_prompt_pairs.assessment: Similar young dark-haired oval-face family; beard, nose/jaw proportions and camera angle differ. Looks plausibly different but related; cannot rule out same-person-like outputs from two samples.
Most visibly different pair: facial proportions, gray hair, pose/framing and age appearance differ. Both remain coherent faces.
Same centered short-hair portrait family;005 has more angular/narrower face and stronger brow than004. Some variation, still a strong repeated template.
Similar silver-haired bearded older-man family;006 front-facing and007 profile could plausibly be views of a similar or same person. Do not count pose change alone as demonstrated identity novelty.

cross_prompt_diversity: Across four prompts, distinct age/hair/face styles are visible; within-prompt identity diversity is weakly evidenced by just two seeds. Hash uniqueness is not used as an identity measure. Need a larger fixed-prompt fresh-noise set and cross-model paired-seed comparison.

Legitimate broad white clerical collars are acceptable for the goal. small_white_tab and black-shirt observations are research prompt-compliance diagnostics only; missing an exact tab alone does not reject goal quality.
